search_lead.cognate: Armenian առն (genitive singular of ayr) and Sanskrit naraḥ continue the man-word *h2ner-. No second cognate member of the maxim is established.
search_lead.argument: Armenian praises showing personal worth for one day and dying rather than living long in disgrace. The searched Sanskrit passages recommend blazing briefly rather than smoking for long. This is a closer heroic temporal antithesis than any slab partner; retain for review of a potentially renewed maxim, not as a demonstrated inherited formula. Armenian lacks the fire image, and literary diffusion or independent moralizing remain possible.
